meta.message: I made a 64x128 one-shot weaken debuff, about 12 frames at 12 fps, side view with no ground ellipse: grey-purple down-arrows fall through the figure's upper body while dark shadow and drips sink down the body. No sprite came with your message, so the man isn't in the preview; the effect is centred on where a standing figure would be. Try the Drips and Arrows sliders on the page, and upload a sprite if you want it fitted to your character.
